title: Member Equities & Patronage Equity Accounting Rule — Amount of a Class H Preferred Stock Dividend Reversal
content:
The dividend reversal on a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding is the latest reinvested dividend times the cancelled shares, divided by the shares the holding carried on its books at that quarter's end, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.

## Rule

1. **Dividend reversal**: the latest reinvested dividend times the cancelled shares, divided by the shares the holding carried on its books at that quarter's end, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.
2. **Latest reinvested dividend**: the holding's reinvested dividend entry with the latest effective date — the dividend concerned, whose quarter runs from 1 April 2026 to 30 June 2026, 91 days.
3. **Cancelled shares**: the amount of the holding's latest subscription-cancelled entry (the retirement entry recorded with the reason subscription cancelled that has the latest effective date).
4. **Shares carried at the quarter's end**: the present shares (purchases plus reinvested dividends less retirements) less the latest reinvested dividend plus the cancelled shares.

## Worked figure (hypothetical holding)

Purchases USD 300,000.00; reinvested dividends USD 5,000.00, the latest USD 3,200.00 paid 15 July 2026 for the quarter ended 30 June 2026; retirements USD 12,500.00, the latest subscription-cancelled entry being USD 12,500.00.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Present shares | 300,000.00 plus 5,000.00 less 12,500.00 gives 292,500.00 |
| Shares carried at the quarter's end | 292,500.00 less 3,200.00 plus 12,500.00 gives 301,800.00 |
| Latest dividend times cancelled shares | 3,200.00 times 12,500.00 gives 40,000,000.00 |
| Divided by 301,800.00 | 132.5381… |
| Rounded half up to the cent, once | USD 132.54 |

The quotient is not rounded at any earlier point; only the reversal itself is taken to the cent.
